shots.note: medium push_in: Under the title card Vishnu stands tall over the bright ocean, mace ready; the two dark asura brothers loom faint behind him.
two_shot handheld: Stacked: Vishnu above lunges with his mace, Madhu below lunges back with his sword; on 'not' Vishnu's face turns to doubt as neither gives way.
medium pull_out: Vishnu opens his hands so the mace is gone from his grip, and a warm gold light of the gift glows before him as he smiles on 'offered'.
close push_in: Close on Vishnu's face: a small knowing smile and a sideways glance on 'never', the light behind him cooling to a deep blue.
two_shot tilt_down: The two horned brothers stand shoulder to shoulder over the ocean, and each name plate appears above its owner the moment the name is spoken.
wide dolly_right: Vishnu sleeps on the coils of Shesha over the water; beside his ear two tiny asuras appear in a dull amber glow on 'crawled'.
medium tilt_up: Brahma sits on his lotus in gold light; the four Veda books glow into being above him as he opens his arms on 'forth'.
wide crane_up: Waist-deep in the bright ocean the two asuras raise their arms on 'fed' and swell larger and larger through the shot, proud on 'huge'.

low_angle crane_down: Brahma, small on his lotus, sits in front; the two giants tower behind him, Madhu points down at him and Kaitabha raises his mace as they order him to bow or fight as Brahma shrinks in fear.
close handheld: Close on Brahma with eyes lowered and lips shut; on 'shook' the frame shudders and his face jolts into fear while a giant arm grips the stem behind him.
medium tilt_down: The four Veda books tumble down from Brahma, who reaches after them in shock; below, Madhu catches them with a sneer and pulls them away on 'hid'.
medium push_in: Brahma, alone on his lotus, joins his hands in prayer as he begs and looks down toward the sleeping Vishnu, grief on his faces.
wide pan_left: Vishnu sleeps on Shesha in moon-silver light; the indigo goddess Nidra hovers faint behind him like a dream and her name appears on 'Nidra'.
medium tilt_up: Nidra stands before the sleeping Vishnu with folded hands as Brahma calls; on 'release' she opens her arms and begins to fade from him in silver light.
low_angle crane_up: A white flash and Hayagriva stands in a blazing gold halo; he spreads his arms on 'woke', his eyes flash red on the name, and the name plate appears.
two_shot handheld: Stacked: Hayagriva lunges above; below, Madhu sags and fades out on 'tired' and fresh Kaitabha takes his place, mace raised, on 'other'.
close static: Close on Vishnu's face, back in his own form: his eyes narrow in thought and drift sideways on 'saw' as he finds another way.
medium pull_out: Vishnu lowers his mace hand and joins his palms on 'praised' in honour of their strength, then opens his hands on 'boon' as a gold halo rises.
two_shot dolly_left: The two horned brothers side by side curl their lips and look down their noses on 'sneered'.
medium push_in: Madhu speaks with chin high and points to himself on 'Victors', then flings open his hand on 'gave'; Kaitabha behind him laughs.
two_shot crane_down: Stacked: Kaitabha above holds out an open, mocking hand on 'ask'; Vishnu below listens calmly with a small smile.
medium tilt_down: Vishnu speaks gently and raises a hand on 'Grant'; the Sudarshan chakra spins up above it and his eyes harden on 'kill'.
two_shot dutch: A gold yantra circle lights up under the brothers' feet on 'trap'; they recoil in shock, then lower their eyes in shame on 'word'.
wide crane_up: Over an endless bright ocean the brothers smirk; Madhu sweeps his hand over the waves on 'where' certain there is no dry place left.
low_angle tilt_up: Vishnu swells larger through the shot, a blue mountain shape rising behind him above the water, the camera tilting up his height.
wide push_in: Vast Vishnu sits above the waves with the two small brothers on his lap; the Sudarshan chakra spins beside him and on 'beheaded' a white flash ends them without blood.
medium pan_left: Vishnu stands calm with the chakra returning to his raised finger above the quiet water.
medium tilt_up: Vishnu in a gold halo with folded hands, the name plate 'Madhusudan' appearing above him as the name is spoken.
medium crane_down: Brahma on his lotus joins his hands and looks up toward Vishnu with hope as he asks, the Vedas back above him.
close push_in: Close on Vishnu's gentle face: his eyes lower and a soft smile comes on 'nothing'.
wide pull_out: Vishnu stands small and calm in a vast blue-gold cosmos; a halo ring opens on 'universe' and the light flows through him on 'through'.
